reviews.text: 为什么国区玩家的容忍度这么低呢？ 大家应该都知道EA抢先版的意思，说白了就是半成品，独立游戏工作室没有强大的资本支持，需要先上回口血，跟国内游戏大厂做出完整版再上线，是不一样的。 通过体验可以说前线的固然BUG很多，优化不好，画质模糊，体验很差，但是不能掩盖他玩法丰富，科技线非常多，宣传片上的内容都可以在游戏内实现，这只是时间的问题。 Rust用了好几年才达到现在的完成度 方舟，七日杀刚出来的时候糟的像坨屎 赛博朋克2077刚上线的时候评价也很糟糕 骑砍2到现在还在打磨 所以朋友们，给这个游戏一点时间吧

我的容忍度其实很高的，作为一个画质烂的一批，角色笨重移速极慢让玩家难受的一批，Ai蠢的一批，可交互搜刮内容少的一批等等各种脑残设计，我都能忍受。你游戏不是抢鲜体验吗？可以没问题，给你时间去修复这些“小”问题，但是！任何事情你得适可而止！这游戏里的很多bug已经属于恶性BUG了，达到让你玩都没得玩的程度，所有的合成台系统只要你退出合成台界面就会直接吞掉你当前的合成队列和资源，你一个生存游戏里最核心的内容还能出这么离谱的BUG，工作认真点可以吗？ （此条评论当天下午3点） 行，你把这个吞队列的bug修复了，不错，算快的，然后下一步：不是所有人都喜欢在超多人的大服务器里玩生存游戏，所以我等着你们什么时候可以把永远连不上的个人本地联机搞好。 （10月13日）行，本地联机你解决了，接下来，木头烧完之后队列被迫停掉也会出现以前吞队列和材料的情况，组队界面看不到队友和自己，拉不起倒地队友，后于领地旗放的设备队友用不了，老实说我没弄懂你这个领地旗是什么情况，到底怎么样才算是共用一个领地旗的队友。全是bug，你们自己看看别人给你的反馈吧，我打几个小时，我都快记不清到底遇到过哪些bug了。

首先游戏是很好玩的，但是有些机制却让游玩过程变得使人烦躁。本游戏吸引我的地方在于飞机坦克装甲车的现代大战，但是当我做出一把枪 以及一辆坦克之后一切都变了，高昂的子弹制作费用让我不得不开半自动来节省子弹，但即便如此几次出门之后我一天的劳作都将被消耗，而战利品只有少许的经验。霰弹枪的弹药1：2 步枪弹药1:3 手枪弹药1:5 为何不增加一些制作比例呢？然后就是游戏里非常重要的蓝图系统，你能想象白色品质的一把电锯仅仅需要不到10个钢锭 而它的红色品质缺需要数量庞大的 1200个钢锭？而电锯的效率提升不足一倍，如果你积攒了非常久的材料做出红色品质的电锯之后，你会发现迎接你的是高昂的维修费用，红色品质的电锯维修费用也高达1000钢锭 这不是任何一个小队可以承担的。此外就是怪物的问题，怪物的索敌不受障碍物的影响而且怪物走路没有脚步！当我偷偷的在搜索物资，一个敌人偷偷的攻击我一下是非常吓人的！当我搬家到沙漠地区之后，途经一座小镇时一个名为撼地者的怪物一次攻击几乎使我的载具报废，而当我下车准备用我为数不多的子弹击杀它时（只有400发子弹）它却丢了一块石头将我400的血量直接清空，而且它丢石头的速度非常之快以至于我没有反应过来就倒地而亡。 在我体验了30多小时游戏之后我决定给出以下建议。 1.提高所以弹药的制作产出，降低弹药成本。 2.减少高品质蓝图的制作成本，并降低高品质装备的维修成本。 3.修改怪物的索敌设定，并延长怪物的攻击动画时长，放大怪物的脚步声。 4.改变维修方式，如添加一系列如武器维修工具 工具维修包 护甲维修工具一类的物品，让玩家可以使用较为低廉的材料制作出维修装备的物品，尤其是载具，接近损毁的载具维修费用等于新做一辆载具。 关于未来发展的建议：本游戏目前游玩感受类似于方舟生存进化，但是本游戏题材应该更贴近于RUST,等级是目前游戏的一切。这使得一些明明非常好的游戏内容，却应为等级而不得不放弃，就比如我非常喜欢黑色武士这把步枪，而当我等级高之后我却不得不换掉它，这是非常令人伤心的。 我希望您的游戏可以越来越好，虽然首发不是非常完美，但是你要知道rust当年也是从60人民币的价格涨到了160元。（没想到写了900多字，要是我在学校写作文能写这么多该多好啊）英语部分是机翻，有语法问题请谅解。 The game is fun at first, but some of the mechanics make playing it frustrating. What attracted me to this game was the modern battle of aircraft, tanks and armored vehicles, but everything changed after I made a gun and a tank, the high cost of bullet production made me have to drive semi-automatic to save bullets, but even after a few trips, my day's work will be consumed, and the loot is only a little experience. Shotgun ammo 1:2 Rifle ammo 1:3 Pistol ammo 1:5 Why not increase the crafting ratio? Then there is the very important blueprint system in the game, can you imagine that a white quality chainsaw requires less than 10 ingots and its red quality requires a huge number of 1200 ingots? The efficiency of the chainsaw is less than double, if you accumulate a very long time of materials to make a red quality chainsaw, you will find that you are greeted by high maintenance costs, and the maintenance cost of the red quality chainsaw is as high as 1000 steel ingot, which is not any team can bear. In addition, there is the problem of monsters, monsters are not affected by obstacles and monsters walk without feet! When I secretly search for supplies, an enemy secretly attack me is very scary! When I moved to the desert, passing through a small town, a monster named Earth Shaker almost destroyed my vehicle with an attack, and when I got out of the car to kill it with my few bullets (only 400 bullets), it threw a stone and emptied me of 400 health. And it was throwing rocks so fast that I fell down dead before I knew it. After playing the game for over 30 hours, I decided to give the following advice. 1. Increase the production output of all ammunition and reduce the cost of ammunition. 2. Reduce the production cost of high-quality blueprints and reduce the maintenance cost of high-quality equipment. 3. Modify the monster's rope setting, and extend the monster's attack animation length, and amplify the monster's footsteps. 4. Change the maintenance method, such as adding a series of items such as weapon repair tools tool repair kit armor repair tools, so that players can use relatively cheap materials to make maintenance equipment items, especially vehicles, the maintenance cost of vehicles close to damage is equal to making a new vehicle. Suggestions for future development: the game currently feels similar to the Ark Survival evolution, but the game genre should be more closely related to RUST, and the level is everything in the current game. This leads to some very good game content that has to be abandoned because of the level, for example, I love the Black Samurai rifle, and when I get higher, I have to replace it, which is very sad. I hope your game can get better and better. Although the first launch is not perfect, you should know that rust also increased its price from 60 RMB to 160 RMB in that year. 服务器设置非常详细（好评，好评，好评，他娘的你可真是个天才） 人物模型以及AI模型（差评） 鹰就是方舟照搬，人类AI特别非常呆，就跟侠盗猎车手圣安地列斯一样，但是他妈枪法巨准 搜刮类似腐烂国度（差评）一个屋就一个箱子按住 转一圈 科技树 （差评） 分了很多类别 很乱很像阿特拉斯还是阿斯特拉忘了反正就是就是海盗内个 任务（差评如潮）海量进阶版七日撒，你解锁了一个奥利奥 你得扭一扭 舔一舔 泡一泡 吃完了么 你解锁了一个垃圾桶 做垃圾桶，解锁袋子，套袋子哦 扔到外面可回收垃圾桶里哦，去街上找可回收垃圾桶需要穿衣服才能出门哦，先穿袜子哦 做了给20点经验，二十几级才能有枪枪哦，你想biabiabia是要乖乖做任务的哦 地图（ 好评）方舟/人渣大小 + 腐烂国度自动类型标记， 附近地标会显示 ？去了 红色的是敌人，蓝色是搜刮 物品（差评如潮）搜刮会有一种方舟里捡了个白色空投给我木头建筑一套的感觉，随便一摸就是各种奇怪小建筑 但是以方舟体量来说 给你俩钢地板 俩钢天花板 你觉得蛋疼么，一个海边村落三四个房子就给几个这玩意？玩家搜刮是为了要工具啊！还有地上有西瓜 这个是人渣的，所有食物饮料都是有耐久的，哥们儿这真不是开着海蛟号出来度假的啊，前期海边捕鱼是最优选，后期种地了肯定就不缺饭 操作（差评）1不能攀爬 2不能翻窗 3这个视距能不能拉远点？你不觉得视野越大越不晕么 咱抄一下PUBG好么？ 建筑（差评）这领地旗是真的无聊，已经是缝合怪了你不如就直接抄Vrising内样直接就是个地砖按地上，然后给维护物品，而且好多人就是奔着PVE来的压根就用不到你这东西 东西对味，而且很对。 虽然是个PVP为主的游戏，但是作为和朋友玩过家家来说没啥毛病。 但是优化很差，负责任的说如果你打算三人以下玩 建议资源获取倍率拉高，采集x50都不过分。 不如七日杀，不如腐烂国度，只能说未来可期， 大胆预测预计25年大约会是高度完成状态，如果那时候火了，应该会踩着方舟2恰肉，方舟2都喝不到汤。 如果做的没啥多大改进，那我估计到时候这游戏打折不到20

现在拯救这个游戏的唯一方法： 开放创意工坊 游戏开发者更新内容太太太太太太慢了，一个自动补充弹药的箱子这么关键的建筑都一拖再拖。开放创意工坊，你信不信玩家分分钟给你做出来，还能做出来自动化模组。 游戏既然走缝合路线，就应该借鉴其他游戏在创意工坊上的成功。Minecraft的成功来自于他的模组，僵尸毁灭工程也是，方舟也是，每个成功的游戏都有强大的创意工坊做支撑。 你们开发者只需要全力开发游戏系统就行了，零散的创意由我们来做。 我已经准备把我的世界工业2模组、无尽模组搬到The front 里来了。还准备写个自动化模组。 赶紧开放创意工坊吧，这是大幅提高游戏可玩性的重要途径。 2025.07.25 我已经研究UE4SS模块研究了很长时间了，还是没能实现在游戏内添加mod。可能要等官方出mod编辑器了

***I Only recommend it at $10 sale price*** This game could be really nice but it suffers from a few glaring issues which I will outline in hopes that the Devs see it and take it seriously. I would submit tickets but that process annoys me. Feel free to spend your time doing that if you think it will help. Given the state of developers these days I doubt anything will change and this may just end up being another high potential game that gets abandoned after the money slows. 1. AI - a. Zombie AI is trash, they are dumb, easy to avoid and a very underwhelming threat. b. Animal AI is unreactive, they stand still and let you walk right up to them and bash them on the head. This makes hunting super unrewarding and dull. Just grinding from animal bones and hide without any stealth skill required. Boars should be aggressive, deer should flee...shouldn't be that complicated. 2. Optimization - Frame chugging on medium settings on a rig that smashes games like ARK, 7DTD and Icarus on max settings without any issues. I hit a zone around a church that causes massive lag and frame drops and eventually totally crashed my PC. This was most certainly an issue with the game not the hardware since when I reloaded, it happened again in the same location. Fix clipping. Clipping through doors and walls is pretty bad in 2026. 3. UI - The UI is quite nice as it is but it can be a bit confusing for new players who are unused to games like ARK. The tutorial is so benign that a player might not even see it. I would suggest a story like campaign that sends the player through a village to find journal entries that guide them through the different mechanics in the game. This could be a separate single player experience just to get new players acclimated. 4. Server - Everything is done through a server which is fine I guess but for solo players this always online function can also contribute to poor performance. I would highly suggest a totally offline single player mode. 5. Emptiness - The world feels empty, POIs are there but they kind of suck. They are flat and dull. Rooms are empty, only crates are lootable. I see a medicine cabinet on a wall I want to be able to open it and find meds. I see a trash can and I want to search it. I see a woodpile and I want to be able to take my hatchet to it and get wood. I see a bed and I want to be able to sleep in it. The mines are just big open pits, I'd like to see a mix between pit mines and more traditional mine shafts to explore where a zombie may be right around the corner waiting to scare you. 6. Cross-platform - This is almost a necessity for a game like this. Iron out the issues I laid out above and port it to console. This game would explode on console as 7dtd and ARK are proof that console players are hungry for open world survival crafting games. But you have to fix the game first. With all this in mind, I do recommend the game at the $10 sale price. I wouldn't pay any more than that right now and I don't see signs of improvement lately.

TL;DR fun survival game with nice basebuilding and exploring, but the playerbase is very small. Worth getting on sale for PvE solo / buddies. If you enjoy 7D2D, Icarus, VEIN, Ark, Survive the Nights etc. then this game might scratch your survival itch. The Front is a cool survival building game but don't expect it to have regular updates (last small update is from Jan 26) as the servers are mostly empty or just a handful of players. I've only played solo PvE for 10 hours, building a base, upgrading it and my gear, which is by far the best part of the game. Exploring the map is interesting and PoI's can be found regularly. Later on you can get vehicles which will make traveling faster. There's a lot of inventory managment when building stuff. Chop wood, gather bushes and mine ore, take it to your forge, wait for it to melt, take it to your crafting station and craft the stuff you need. Leveling up gives you access to new upgrades. You also need to take care of hunger, thirst and warmth. There are blueprints for different tier items that let's you for example build stronger walls or better stat weapons. For all I know you can get these by "defending a beacon" which basically means you get waves of enemies attacking the beacon you must defend. There's also some sort of cosmetic crate you get from playing the game that'll give you a weapon skin every few hours. I got 2 during my playtime. If you have buddies to play with then I think it's worth the 10€ on sale. If you play solo PvE and like building, gathering resources and exploring it's worth getting on sale. If you like huge PvP fights then nope, the playerbase is too small. (137 peak past 24 hours and most seem to play solo) Pros + Map is pretty big + Vehicles and upgrades + Clunky animals you can hunt + Game looks nice and runs "okay" + Steady upgrades as you level up + Securing your base and fighting hordes + Decent amount of building parts and resources + Server settings let you customize a lot of things Cons - Handful of players - A bit clunky here and there - Lack of updates is a bit worrying - No dual-wielding a weapon and a flashlight as far as I know - Most of the items in the world can't be interacted with or destroyed - Animals like deer, fox and boar just stand there until you hit them making hunting a bit potato - You hit a zombie and they start walking towards you, you hit them another time and they might start running. No idea why this is a thing. Maybe they should run after the first hit and not randomly - You can't pin recipes as far as I know, meaning you go back and forth your storage boxes trying to remember what resources you need Edit: well, the game is pretty badly optimized. In some areas the fps can go from 60 to as low as 20.

The Front was a fun and solid game at the start, the player base has unfortunately died out, and it suffers from too many technical issues. It attempts to blend elements from various survival games, but the execution falls flat and the overall polish is poor. It was a promising title, but sadly, it is certainly not one I would recommend.

Yet another game that I wish I could say I'm in the middle on. I ultimately opted to not recommend because for how long this game has been out, it has some surprisingly bad resource balance issues and one awful mechanic where once your health is depleted, it gives you a red bar that slowly goes down and you can't revive yourself or do anything unless you are playing with someone who can revive you. Terrible mechanic. The manual miner is just dumb in this game. Devs literally invite you to AFK resource collection to the point where you might as well walk away for 30 minutes to an hour. Sitting on the manual miner for 5 minutes yields ridiculously little oil/ore. Looting is also way too direct and boring with only being able to loot neon colored chests that kill the feeling of actually looting a settlement/stronghold. This game could be incredible given the ability to craft vehicles including helicopters and its overall tech system but it has a very long way to go.
